name: Secunda - Story of the North
source:
Secunda is a visual novel in a dark fantasy setting, where you play as a lord possessed by a demon of desire - the Archon of an old and fading northern coven. This is a story written from the perspective of a villain of a thousand hearts, a dark lord and an evil omen.

In the world of the fallen empire of black magic and forbidden cults, a violent, black soul of a thousand-headed snake flourishes - the heir of an ancient family was born in a house of malicious and gloomy, where the lands of winter last for years and nights - for months. Here the stream of consciousness and sensuality opens from a restless and passionate soul, and its mind is formed along with the growth of the nature of their master within - and with them vice and perversion consume their allies, home and lovers. 

Your heart and love are immeasurable - protect your coven from an ill will, fill their cup to the brim and continue to fight for power and omnipotence in the name of the black hand -  know the darkest creatures of your world and build alliances that will shake the archipelago.

"History of the North" is the first part of the cycle, a prologue to a long story about violent, cloudy heads - but it can also be read as a full-fledged novel, with an open ending and a colorful, flowery and gothic narration. 

The four beloveds grabbed hold of the Archon with an iron grip - each of them is a full story about the fall and corruption of a person, a set of manipulations and worries, and darkness and vice of a passionate and sensual nature. 

Among them is the devilish Lord of Serpents and desires, the source and world of your existence, the sensual beast of the all-devouring logos; Huldra, the embodiment of beauty and rapacity lurking in your noble home; Veela, the lord of the fjords, standing like a vulture over your figure and decaying from non-incarnate passion; and the Warlock, priest of the Mare, Lady of Omens, your pestilence-weary, violent and rebellious soulmate standing with you against the whole world. 

[From [url=https://aukanemin.itch.io/secunda]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Secunda》是一部黑暗奇幻背景的视觉小说，你在游戏中扮演一位被欲望恶魔附身的领主——一个古老而衰落的北方族群的执政官。这是一个以千心反派、黑暗领主、凶兆为视角写的故事。

在黑魔法和禁忌邪教的没落帝国的世界里，一条暴力的千头蛇的黑色灵魂蓬勃发展——一个古老家族的继承人出生在一座充满恶意和阴暗的房子里，那里的冬天持续了数年和数夜——长达数月。在这里，意识和肉欲的流从不安分和热情的灵魂中打开，它的思想随着他们内在主人的本质的成长而形成——罪恶和变态也随之吞噬了他们的盟友、家庭和爱人。

你的心和爱是不可估量的 - 保护你的族群免受恶意侵害，将他们的杯子装满，并继续以黑手的名义为权力和无所不能而战 ​​- 了解你世界中最黑暗的生物，并建立将撼动群岛的联盟。

《北方的历史》是该系列的第一部分，是一个关于暴力、阴沉的头脑的长篇故事的序幕，但它也可以作为一部成熟的小说来阅读，它有开放式结局和丰富多彩、华丽和哥特式的叙述。

这四个心爱的人用铁腕抓住了执政官——他们每个人都是一个关于一个人的堕落和腐败、一系列操纵和担忧、以及充满激情和感性本质的黑暗和罪恶的完整故事。

其中有邪恶的蛇和欲望之王，你存在的源头和世界，吞噬一切的理性的感官野兽；Huldra，潜伏在你高贵家园中的美丽和贪婪的化身；维拉，峡湾之主，像秃鹰一样站在你的身躯上，因非化身的激情而腐烂；还有术士、母马祭司、预兆女士，你厌倦了瘟疫、暴力而叛逆的灵魂伴侣，与你一起对抗整个世界。

[来自[url=https://aukanemin.itch.io/secunda]itch.io[/url]]
